claims: Product-derived monochrome views show three distinct registered endpoint readings with 5, 6, and 7 open petals and a visibly partial intermediate transition.
The sealed design exposes one right-edge rotor control for one continuous hand-powered optical transformation and aligns with Luma Vale's geometry-first ambient-light method.
agent-playtest.evidence_class: native-agent design review plus sealed product-derived views and deterministic optical geometry

claims: The copied sealed CAD project independently passed source fit/spec audits, a 37-sample full-turn rigid clearance sweep, axial loading/capture checks, and a compressed-head snap-seating envelope check.

Nominal geometry provides 0.30 mm spindle radial, 0.40 mm guide radial, and 0.30 mm axial rotor clearance; exact endpoints isolate 5, 6, and 7 petals with no nonselected intersections or portal leaks in the encoded audits.
The combined and part STEP/mesh outputs are byte-reproducible across two fresh processes.
mechanical-check.evidence_class: independent deterministic digital geometry, fit, optical-state, motion-proxy, interference, and reproducibility audit

claims: All three sealed slicer-facing STL targets fit a 220 x 220 x 250 mm bed and are watertight, manifold, consistently wound, positive-volume single shells.
At a 0.4 mm nozzle and 0.80 mm two-line wall gate, all three sealed STL targets have zero failing sampled surface points.
The three broad-face-down source constructions are digitally eligible for the intended support-free orientation.
printability-check.evidence_class: independent deterministic digital mesh, bed-fit, thickness, and source-form audit

limitations: No physical print, printer-process fit, or support-free outcome has been observed.
Snap insertion force, retention, service removal, whitening, fracture, and fatigue remain unverified.
Detent force, feel, wear, and bidirectional cycle life remain unverified.
Optical brightness, off-axis appearance beyond the checked geometric rays, pocket comfort, recognition, discovery, and human response remain unverified.
summary: A pocket-sized, three-part ambient-light garden whose single exposed right-edge dial reveals Cassiopeia, Cygnus, and a Little Dipper reading within Ursa Minor at three indexed positions.
title: Moonwake Garden
what_arrives: Ready-to-print CAD for the rear chassis, sector dial, and garden face as three separate print targets.
MANUAL.pdf, a four-page A5 owner guide covering assembly, first use, operation, troubleshooting, care, and safety.
